summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed Form 8-K covering Items 3.02 and 8.01. Item 3.02 discloses the unregistered sale of 8,634,316 common shares across multiple classes (Class S, I, F-S, F-I) for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $91.3 million, priced at NAV per share as of June 30, 2026, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S. Item 8.01 reports a routine monthly distribution declaration for all seven share classes, payable cash or via distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine capital raise and dividend announcement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring.
